paragraphs.text: Efuan Pincar is a kingdom on the great island of Gulmany , part of the Terisian Isles on modern day Dominaria

The kingdom and its capital Pincar City lie on the northernmost part of the island of Gulmany , at the foot of the Ohran Mountains . This is the location of the former Ronom Glacier . It is considered the most remote part of the Terisian Isles .

According to local scribes, Efuan Pincar was populated around the year 2950 AR , during the early stages of the Flooding of Terisiare . The Ronom Glacier had been melting rapidly for 16 years by the presumed time that the boats carrying Efuand settlers arrived there. . Sages and wizards from the School of the Unseen helped found the new nation, and at some point, Avohir came to be worshipped as a deity there.

300 years later, during the later stages of the the Thaw , parts of Efuan Pincar was infiltrated by Phyrexian sleeper agents created by the praetor Gix . This threat was negated by Urza 's machines. Efuan Pincar was also the birthplace of Ratepe .
